clauses.text: Vendor shall deliver: (1) Current-state assessment report, (2) Process optimization roadmap, (3) Implementation plan with milestones, (4) Training materials.
Deliverables subject to 10-day acceptance review. Customer may reject once with specific deficiencies; vendor has 5 days to cure.
Customer owns all work product created under SOW. Vendor retains ownership of pre-existing tools and methodologies.
50% upon execution, 25% at mid-point milestone, 25% upon final deliverable acceptance.
Customer may terminate for convenience with 30 days notice. Fees owed for work completed plus wind-down costs.
Vendor liability capped at fees paid under this SOW, excluding gross negligence and willful misconduct.

risks.title: Aggressive Payment Terms (50% Upfront)
risks.description: 50% payment upon execution creates financial risk if deliverables are unsatisfactory or vendor fails to perform.
risks.mitigation: Negotiate 30% upfront, 30% at milestones, 40% upon final acceptance to align payment with value delivery.

risks.title: Low Liability Cap
risks.description: Liability capped at SOW fees (likely $120K) may be insufficient for consulting errors causing operational disruption.
risks.mitigation: Negotiate 2-3x SOW fees for professional errors and omissions.

risks.title: No Performance Guarantees
risks.description: SOW lacks KPIs or performance metrics for process optimization outcomes.
risks.mitigation: Add measurable success criteria (e.g., '15% efficiency improvement' or 'reduce cycle time by X days').

talking_points: Payment should align with value delivery and deliverable acceptance
Industry standard for fixed-price projects is 20-30% upfront
Protects against vendor non-performance or quality issues
risk_callouts: Ensure final payment contingent on deliverable acceptance, not just submission

talking_points: Consulting errors could cause operational disruption exceeding SOW value
Professional services agreements typically have 2-3x liability caps
Vendor should carry E&O insurance to backstop higher cap
risk_callouts: Clarify cap excludes IP indemnification and confidentiality breaches

playbook.fallback: Qualitative success criteria with measurement framework
talking_points: Measurable outcomes justify investment and enable vendor accountability
Process optimization should have quantifiable business impact
risk_callouts: Agree on baseline metrics and measurement methodology upfront

audit.reviewReason: Payment terms and liability cap require procurement/legal review
